hypotheses.justification: Neither the statement nor the proof enumerates B: p and q are just functions into B. The pointwise argument after unfolding probability and expectation works for arbitrary B, so this instance can be deleted.

Neither collision nor definedEquality requires enumerating Y; both test whether the same value is returned. The pointwise proof works without this instance. In particular, if Y is empty, the existential collision condition is false and definedEquality is 0. Both this and [Fintype B] can be deleted together; [Fintype A] remains needed for FiniteDistribution A.
